title: Data translation system
summary: Models and visual rules for translating population, density and place data into comparable forms.

lensAssignments.rationale: The responsibility centres on defining the place-data model, translation rules, comparison structure and system boundaries.
The translation rules are expressed through a consistent spatial and visual language.
lensAssignments.lensSummary: Brand and experience-system responsibility: applying a coherent visual language to spatial-data translation.
